title: Mahendra v. State of U.P. and Another
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; theft-dues recovery withdrawn; fresh order after hearing.
headnote: Challenge to a demand notice for recovery of electricity dues in a theft case. The department stated that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after hearing. The writ was disposed of with liberty to the department to pass that fresh order after following the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: The petitioner, Mahendra, filed a writ against the State of Uttar Pradesh and the electricity department challenging the demand notice dated 18 October 2022 for recovery of electricity dues in a case of theft of electricity. Counsel for the department stated that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn and that a fresh order would be passed after affording the petitioner an opportunity of hearing.

holding_units.topic: Fresh order after hearing in a theft-dues recovery
holding_units.holding: On the department's statement that the impugned recovery had been withdrawn, the writ was disposed of with liberty to pass a fresh order after affording the petitioner an opportunity of hearing and after following the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: The order does not cite clause 3.3(e). It refers only to the procedure prescribed under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: The Court disposed of the writ when the department withdrew the impugned theft-dues recovery, and left the department at liberty to pass a fresh order after following the procedure under the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, including the hearing the department had undertaken to give.

not_decided.point: Whether any sum was recoverable for the alleged theft of electricity
not_decided.note: The impugned recovery was withdrawn. Any fresh order, and the dues it may determine, were left to the department.
